items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: You had a little anecdote about on the radio thing playing behind David Bartholomew... Well he definitely dropped a beat... especially a griot, an icon as Dave Bartholomew.

ctx.x: You had a little anecdote about on the radio thing playing behind David Bartholomew and he was playing “Body and Soul” and he — it sounded to me like maybe he dropped a beat here and there.

Well he definitely dropped a beat and you know, and the same thing with singers. It’s not about being right and wrong, you make whatever — no. Your role as an accompanist is to justify what happens. You’re accompanying them. And just because they may have gotten a point off on their musicology final exam doesn’t mean that you leave them out to dry, and especially a griot, an icon as Dave Bartholomew. But Dr. John called me up at the radio station, “Yeah I heard what you did bro, that was nice.”
You caught that, you fixed that.
